chunks: And Samāʿah ibn Mihrān narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no prayer in the two Eids except with an Imam, and if you pray alone, then there is no harm."

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader whose presence is tied to the Eid prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eid festivals, Eid al-Fiṭr and Eid al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can the Eid prayer be performed without an Imam or alone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the salat of the two Eids, linking its ideal performance to the presence of an Imam. It also states that if a person performs it alone, there is no harm, indicating permissibility in that case.
